name: @kitr/kit-server
description: kitr new --kit server: A pure backend: h3 server, Adonis-style API, logger, db binding, realtime channels. No React in the bundle.

kitr.name: server
kitr.title: Server kit
kitr.summary: Start a pure backend: h3 server, API routes, logger, database and realtime channels, no React.

kit.audience: Backend developers who want an API, jobs or a realtime service with no React in the project.

highlights.title: Routes and controllers
highlights.text: `server/routes.ts` maps URLs to controllers in `server/controllers/`, with a health check to start.

highlights.title: Any database
highlights.text: `config/db.ts` connects the ORM you pick, with Drizzle and postgres.js sketched in its comments.

highlights.title: Live channels
highlights.text: `app/channels/example.ts` is a typed channel clients can subscribe to.

highlights.title: Tested without a running server
highlights.text: `test/example.test.ts` calls the API in memory with `createTestClient`.

run: The API on port 3001, restarted on change
Vitest, starting with the API test
